name: M1 · Email intake to ticket (Summit demo)

parameters.content:
## M1 · Email intake to ticket
Gmail → Claude reads the email → 8 validation rules → duplicate & return-visit check (Jobs sheet) → shadow mode? → ticket, or a person on Slack.

**Shadow mode is ON unless the variable `M1_SHADOW_MODE` is `false`.** In shadow mode it only writes to the Log sheet.

Needs: env var `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, Gmail, Google Sheets and Slack credentials, and a Google Sheet ID. See n8n/README.md. Synthetic data only.
